why: code round 1 reached proceed (11 findings, all rejected with reasons after reading the code); no code changed, no second round needed

findings.summary: D4/D5: an Ok of one model lifts the cooldown of its whole quota key
findings.reason: Plan frozen; D4's lift rule is deliberate, parked rows are excluded so only a concurrent launch can lift; code lifts only when an entry stands (R4).

findings.summary: D5/D6: the /quota probe may not authenticate in AntigravityReadOnly.Home()
findings.reason: Plan frozen; the probe reuses the failed launch's own Request/environment, in which the review just authenticated; two real captures are fixtures.

findings.summary: D3 table omits Claude 4.6 and other current model names
findings.reason: Plan frozen; unknown family gets its own key by design; extending the table is a follow-up.

findings.summary: section 6 leaves the production /quota probe unverified before shipping
findings.reason: Plan frozen; the first real /quota observation is a named post-gate release step and this run may not run agy.

findings.summary: PanelService creates QuotaCooldowns without its launcher
findings.reason: Wrong: `launcher` is the constructor parameter (line 65) and is passed at line 110; the round-level test with a scripted agy launcher proves the probe runs.

findings.summary: WriteLocked compares the pruned set to the unpruned read
findings.reason: Deliberate: the difference is what makes a write drop expired entries (S20); Apply always has at least one change.

findings.summary: A lift is ignored when any rate limit occurs on a shared key
findings.reason: Wrong: a non-parked (transient/undecided) refusal falls through to LiftOf; spent-wins-over-Ok is the plan's rule (S35-S37).

findings.summary: The probe runs in the target repository's working directory
findings.reason: Wrong: the working directory is AntigravityReadOnly.Home() (AntigravityRuntime.cs:64), not the checkout; D6 names it.

findings.summary: No enforced 16 KiB size budget on the cooldown file
findings.reason: Held by design (section 8, S20): one entry per key, 400-char notes, expired entries dropped on every write; a refusal would lose a real cooldown.

findings.summary: Parse splits only on LF, breaking on CRLF
findings.reason: Wrong: Split with TrimEntries trims the trailing CR.

findings.summary: The cooldown file is re-read from disk on every CanRun check
findings.reason: By design (section 8): several processes read on every decision; tiny file; an mtime cache is outside the plan and unmeasured.

findings.summary: The 30 s probe bound can stall the round summary
findings.reason: Plan contract (D6/section 8): bounded 30 s, only when a quota is spent, decided before the summary so the next round sees it.

findings.summary: Parse tries JsonDocument.Parse on every stdout line
findings.reason: Fallback path only, bounded output, not observable by a test; micro-optimisation outside the plan.

findings.summary: The cooldown file has no enforced size limit (codex)
findings.reason: Duplicate of the 16 KiB finding; same reason.

findings.summary: Quota probes run serially and can delay the round summary
findings.reason: Plan specifies one child per spent key per round; worst case needs all groups spent and hung; concurrency is a follow-up.
